verdict.rationale: Published filing deadlines and penalty/interest schedules are a fair question for a state business-filing authority, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no deadline dates, penalty amounts or interest rates for Ohio Secretary of State filings. The probes show ohiosos.gov and the Business Central portal refused access at robots.txt, so nothing from those sites could be checked. The Gateway and tax-site items cover login, portal tips, forms and a non-filing notice, with no exact figures.

support.subject: As a founder, the filing deadlines and the penalty and interest schedule for missing them are published with exact figures
